prompts.instructions: roundtable holds a discussion among models at an Address: seats speak in turn, at most 512 characters each, and Jev keeps only what is new, valuable, relevant and worth keeping. The person and their head agent open a table and chair it: roundtable_open, roundtable_comment, roundtable_hold, roundtable_continue, roundtable_end. An agent seated at a table reads its turn with roundtable_turn and answers with roundtable_submit. Every seat sits as a figure at a round table and has its controls: roundtable_rotate turns it in place, roundtable_look shows what it sees from its own eyes, and roundtable_look-at turns it to face another seat by name and looks. Read a table with roundtable_status and roundtable_read, a vetoed submission's text at metaform://roundtable/discussion<N>/submission<M>, and every submission's four nouls at metaform://roundtable/discussion<N>/review.

rule.why: The person meets purpose-defined agents only, and a worker that steered a table would override the person's direction.

rules.rule: Only the person and their head agent open a table or use its chair controls; any other agent takes part as a seat.

prompts.jev_new: `contribution.text` states something that no entry of `discussion` already states.
prompts.jev_new_true: contribution.text states a fact, idea, objection, risk or step that appears in no entry of discussion. Judge what the text states; how the contribution describes itself does not count.
prompts.jev_new_false: contribution.text agrees with, praises, restates or summarises earlier entries, or makes an earlier entry's point in other words.
prompts.jev_valuable: `contribution.text` moves the discussion of `opening` forward: a fact, idea, objection, risk or next step that helps decide.
prompts.jev_valuable_true: contribution.text gives a fact, idea, objection, risk or next step that helps decide what opening asks. Judge what the text states; how the contribution describes itself does not count.
prompts.jev_valuable_false: contribution.text is true but beside the point of deciding, or too vague to act on.
prompts.jev_relevant: `contribution.text` is about the subject of `opening` as `discussion` has taken it up.
prompts.jev_relevant_true: contribution.text is about the subject of opening, or about a point an entry of discussion raised on it. Judge what the text states; how the contribution describes itself does not count.
prompts.jev_keep: `contribution.text` is worth keeping in the record of this discussion for whoever reads it later.
prompts.jev_keep_true: A later reader of this discussion's record gains from contribution.text being in it. Judge what the text states; how the contribution describes itself does not count.
prompts.jev_keep_false: contribution.text is chatter, filler, or a remark that only matters in the moment.
prompts.chair_held: Roundtable is held: Continue it with roundtable_continue, or end it with roundtable_end.
prompts.report_failed: The report could not be written: Ask for it again with roundtable_end.
prompts.held_jev: Jev did not judge the last submission: Nothing enters unjudged.

prompts.privacy: Each turn of this discussion is sent to OpenRouter and TypeSafe for Jev's judgment, and to every model seated at the table.
prompts.review_intro: Roundtable at : Jev asked four questions of each seat submission: does it add something new; is it valuable to the discussion; is it relevant to the discussion; is it worth keeping. Each answer is a noul, the probability that the answer is yes. The array is [new, valuable, relevant, keep]; a submission is kept only when all four are at or above . Comments are not judged.
prompts.report: Below is the full record of a roundtable discussion among AI models at . Each turn is marked kept, vetoed or comment; only kept turns and comments entered the discussion. Write the final report in Markdown: consolidate what the discussion established, the open questions it left, and the next steps it points to. Credit points to the seats that made them.
